articles.title: Corsair Gaming Headsets See Early Prime Big Deal Days Discounts on Amazon UK
articles.summary: Amazon's Prime Big Deal Days doesn't officially kick off until October 6, but we're already seeing some early discounts ahead of the two-day event, including savings on a couple of Corsair's gaming headsets.
body: Right now, you can pick up the Corsair VOID v2 wireless headset for £69.99 or the wired Corsair HS65 SURROUND for £72.78 at Amazon UK. Neither deal is officially part of Prime Big Deal Days yet, but if you've been looking for a new gaming headset, they're worth checking out before the main event gets underway.
Let's start with the Corsair VOID v2, which is down to £69.99 at Amazon UK, a 30% saving.

It's a wireless headset with Corsair's distinctive styling, complete with lighting on the earcups, but there's more to it than looking the part. The VOID v2 packs Dolby Atmos Spatial Audio and custom-tuned 50mm drivers, designed to give you a better sense of where sounds are coming from in games.

That could mean picking up on a stealthy killer creeping around in Dead by Daylight, hearing where a grenade has landed in Battlefield 6, or keeping track of proximity chat in ARC Raiders and Marathon.

articles.title: Avengers: Endgame Encore's Success Sets The Stage For Doomsday
articles.summary: Avengers: Endgame Encore hit theaters this weekend, and it did well enough to show pent-up anticipation for a new Avengers movie to come out. Thankfully, people won't have to wait that long, as Avengers: Doomsday will be released in December.
body: Per Deadline, Avengers: Endgame Encore led the box office this past weekend, with an estimated 3-day gross of $26 million. While that's a far cry from the opening weekend of a brand-new superhero flick, it's impressive for a re-release with only a bit of new footage. Clearly, people are interested in getting an Avengers refresher before Doomsday comes out.

This Encore re-release also pushed Avengers: Endgame's all-time domestic cume to $884.3 million, affirming its status as one of the highest-grossing movies domestically ever alongside Star Wars: The Force Awakens and Spider-Man: Brand New Day.

The success of both Spider-Man: Brand New Day and Avengers: Endgame Encore paints a promising picture for Avengers: Doomsday, which Encore directly sets up with its new post-credit scenes. Don't be surprised if Avengers: Doomsday is a massive hit when it finally releases on Dec. 18.

articles.title: The Real Budget Of Hideo Kojima's Physint Remains A Mystery
articles.summary: After a claim earlier this week suggested that Hideo Kojima's Physint may have cost upwards of $400 million, rampant speculation about the Metal Gear Solid spiritual successor's budget ensued.
body: During The Game Business Show on Sept. 24, Christopher Dring briefly mentioned that Physint had a budget of around $400 million. As Xbox recently signed a publishing deal for Physint before laying off hundreds of developers and restructuring some of its studios, the response to this claim was mixed.

Other reporters quickly denied that Physint cost that much. On ResetEra, Bloomberg's Jason Schreier explained that he is usually "hesitant to get into exact numbers without seeing documentation or corroborating them with multiple firsthand sources," but that "someone at Xbox with firsthand knowledge of the deal told me that they signed Physint for significantly less than this." Windows Central backed that up, with Xbox sources telling the publication that Physint cost "far lower" and a "fraction" of that supposed $400 million figure.

articles.title: Xbox is reportedly paying a "fraction" of the $400 million Kojima quoted Sony for Physint
articles.summary: A reported $400 million budget for Hideo Kojima 's Physint has already been walked back over the weekend, with multiple outlets now saying Xbox is paying nowhere near that figure for Hideo Kojima's stealth game.
body: The number originated from Christopher Dring of The Game Business, who said on his podcast on Friday that Xbox was "signing Kojima for a project often referred to as Physint with a budget around $400 million".

Later, however, Dring himself clarified on X/Twitter that Xbox is likely paying "quite a bit less" than the figure Kojima had originally quoted Sony - Dring originally said he'd heard "everything from $300 million to $600 million, although it's $400 million that is the figure that is bandied around" - and Bloomberg's Jason Schreier said his own sources described Microsoft's negotiated figure as "significantly less than this".
Windows Central's Jez Corden went further, saying Xbox is paying only a "fraction" of it, although neither source reported an actual figure.

Physint, Kojima Productions' action-espionage title and spiritual successor to Metal Gear Solid, was originally announced as a PlayStation project. Sony reportedly spent months negotiating with the studio before pulling its funding after the project exceeded budget and missed deadlines.

articles.title: Flying a Helicopter Is 2026’s Most Stressful Gaming Experience
articles.summary: 2026 has been full of stressful moments in video games. Running away from a huge, flabby monster as Grace Ashcroft in Resident Evil Requiem. Fighting Damien Webb in the sewers in 007 First Light. Losing your grip on the final handhold of a cliff face in Cairn.
body: You'd think flying a helicopter in a video game would be easy, especially in a first-person shooter where its main purpose is to get you to the battlefield. I've flown many a chopper in Grand Theft Auto 5, a fair few in the Battlefield series, not to mention a bunch in the Just Cause games. But Wardogs is different.

First and foremost, Kane Allard, a senior producer at Bulkhead, told me in an interview conducted at Gamescom 2026 that the helicopters in Wardogs were designed by an aeronautical engineer. "A big part of the game is vehicles, and we wanted them to feel as realistic and authentic as possible," Allard explained. "The way we achieved that was by bringing in an aeronautical engineer to design the base layer of our helicopters, just to make them feel realistic and give them weight and make them feel fun. And it gives them that skill level where you can learn and become a better pilot."
A weekly cheat sheet to what you’ll eventually love to play. No buying, no commitment — just saving for later.

articles.title: Star Wars Episode 10 Has Found Its Director
articles.summary: Disney and Lucasfilm just brought on a director for an upcoming Star Wars movie reportedly continuing the Skywalker Saga. It's Jon Watts, a director you know best for his work on the Marvel Cinematic Universe's Spider-Man trilogy.
body: On Sept. 26, The Hollywood Reporter and Knight Edge Media revealed that Jon Watts would direct the first Star Wars movie that's part of "the next phase of a potential new Skywalker Saga." The film is supposedly part of a trilogy Simon Kinberg is writing. Kinberg wrote X-Men: The Last Stand, Days of Future Past, and Apocalypse before directing the infamous Dark Phoenix. Disney hasn't fully greenlit the movie yet, so plot details aren't being readily shared right now.

A potential Episode 10 is far along in development, though, and Disney is quite familiar with Jon Watts' work. Watts helped fold Spider-Man into the MCU, directing Homecoming, Far From Home, and No Way Home. After that, he turned to Star Wars and helped create the underrated Star Wars: Skeleton Crew for Disney Plus, which clearly impressed Lucasfilm enough to give Watts a Skywalker Saga movie.

articles.title: Five Nights at Freddy's is coming to Fortnite for Fortnitemares
articles.summary: Epic has confirmed that Five Nights at Freddy's is joining Fortnite for this year's Fortnitemares event.
body: After months of rumours and teasing, a new trailer formally confirms that Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria will appear as a location on the map, with Freddy, Bonnie, Chica and Foxy all featuring as bosses that players can take on in a fight.
"It's almost showtime!" Epic announced. "The Fazbear Band has taken over Battle Royale. Face the animatronic animal bosses and survive the night… if you can. Fortnitemares begins 1st October!"

The crossover had been expected for a while, with the pizzeria itself appearing on the island during Fortnite's Override season, and recent Fortnitemares hinting at security cameras and FNAF dialogue.

Over the summer, Epic Games settled a court case against a contractor accused of leaking Fortnite information. Former contractor Hayden Cohen agreed to a judgment that bars them from "possessing, accessing, using, or disclosing any of Epic's confidential or trade secret information", including a ban on providing confidential information to other third parties, too.

articles.title: Minecraft is getting its first new dimension in 14 years, and it's called The Sift
articles.summary: Minecraft maker Mojang has announced The Sift, a new Minecraft dimension that will join the Overworld, the Nether, and The End when it launches on Java and Bedrock in 2027. It's the first new dimension added to the game since The End arrived in 2011.
body: The Sift will appear first in Minecraft Dungeons 2, slated for release on 29th September, before coming to the base game next year.

The Sift was announced during Minecraft Live on 26th September, alongside the wider Dungeons 2 reveal. We didn't get much information about it - Mojang is holding back most of the details for now - but did describe it as a new environment that will bring new biomes, mobs, and ways to play and explore. As yet, there's no firm release date.
"Minecraft Live revealed that the newest Minecraft dimension isn't just finding its home in Dungeons 2, it'll also be coming to Minecraft Java & Bedrock Edition next year," the team teased.

"This will be the first new dimension in over 14 years - joining the Overworld, the Nether and the End as our fourth dimension. During the broadcast, you got a glimpse into this dimension in Minecraft - and even one of the mobs that calls it home. But surely that's not enough! Luckily you can experience it for yourself in Minecraft Dungeons 2 - coming September 29, 2026."

articles.title: This ambitious Half-Life 2 mod asks: what if Iron Lung had a submarine and an airship?
articles.summary: Like many people, I'm a big fan of quickfire submarine horror adventure Iron Lung. Yet despite receiving rave reviews and spawning a film adaptation by Markiplier, surprisingly few games have picked up its baton of vehicular terror.
body: Which is why I'm so intrigued by The Temple, an upcoming Half-Life 2 total conversion that likewise lets players pilot a terror submarine. But the temple ups the ante by adapting the scares into two other forms of transportation, taking players out of the depths all the way up into space.

The Temple is set on an aquatic planet dotted by strange, concrete megastructures, which you're tasked with exploring using three separate vehicles. One, as mentioned, is a submarine that will take you into the depths of its ocean. The others are an airship for exploring its skies and abandoned towers, and a space shuttle that lets you travel to asteroidal moons that orbit the planet.

The Temple was originally released as a pair of maps for MapLabs, a mod that collects together maps from various Source engine modding competitions. While that initial version was fairly short—around 20 minutes in length—the total conversion will revamp and expand those two existing maps, while also adding a third map for over two hours of exploration-based sci-fi horror.

articles.title: The spiritual successor to classic JRPG Wild Arms has seemingly been cancelled, four years after its Kickstarter raised nearly $3 million
articles.summary: Armed Fantasia— which was a spiritual successor to the popular JRPG series Wild Arms and not a first-person shooter starring Mickey Mouse—has been cancelled four years after its Kickstarter campaign raised almost $3 million.
body: As reported by Rock Paper Shotgun, Armed Fantasia is one of several titles for which Digital Bros—the parent company of 505 Games—has decided to "discontinue development of" as revealed in its most recent financial statement.

The project was headed by Akifumi Kaneko, who was the lead designer on the original Wild Arms and served in the same role through to Wild Arms 4. It was formally revealed alongside its Kickstater campaign back in 2022. Unlike most video game Kickstarters, where the money raised is used to fund the game directly, this Kickstarter aimed to fund two JRPG prototypes. One was for Armed Fantasia, and the other was for a proof-of-concept of Penny Blood. Both prototypes, it was hoped, would lead to signing a publishing deal that would provide full funding for each game.

articles.title: Star Wars Nabs Spider-Man Director Jon Watts for First Movie in Disney's New Skywalker Saga Trilogy
articles.summary: Disney has reportedly picked Spider-Man director Jon Watts to helm the first movie in Simon Kinberg's new Star Wars trilogy as it plots out the next chapter in the Skywalker Saga.
body: Information about a new series of Star Wars projects from Lucasfilm was first reported by Daniel Richtman and later corroborated by The Hollywood Reporter. Although Watts is best known for leading the charge on the Marvel Cinematic Universe's Tom Holland Spider-Man trilogy, his work on Star Wars would represent his return to the sci-fi franchise following his time as co-creator on 2024's Skeleton Crew.

The yet-to-be-named new films, which are said to be the next chapter in the Skywalker Saga, are being written by Star Wars: Rebels and Mr. and Mrs. Smith veteran Kinberg. Story details remain mostly shrouded in mystery, though it's said that Daisy Ridley's sequel trilogy Jedi, Rey Skywalker, will play a role in the story.

Watts has only been picked to direct the first movie of the new trilogy so far. When this next chapter will begin is also unclear, with The Hollywood Reporter sources noting that Disney has not given the new project the official green light as work on its foundation continues.

articles.title: Final Fantasy 7 director says Revelation's Platinum trophy will be "easier to get"
articles.summary: While Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth was "difficult" to Platinum by "design", sequel Revelation's Platinum trophy will be "easier to get".
body: That's according to director Naoki Hamaguchi, who recently acknowledged that the reason so few players had unlocked Rebirth's Platinum trophy - about 2.6% - is because the team "wanted to make people go through all this content and perfect it".
Now, talking to Anime News Network, Hamaguchi stopped short of calling the tough Platinum requirements "a mistake in judgement", but did admit he had "regrets" when he saw the fan reaction.

"For Rebirth's platinum trophy - well, for Rebirth in general - there's so much to do. There's so much content. We wanted to make people go through all this content and perfect it. It's kind of by design that that would make it difficult," he said.

"So I don't want to call it a mistake in judgment or anything but we also didn't expect so many people to want the platinum trophy. I think that was what we underestimated here. Battle director Teruki Endo also saw [the fan reaction] and was like, 'Oh, no! I feel bad - I have regrets'."
points: While Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth was "difficult" to Platinum by "design", sequel Revelation's Platinum trophy will be "easier to get".

articles.title: Godzilla Minus Zero Review
articles.summary: Review: Godzilla Minus Zero doesn’t disappoint in the slightest on the kaiju front, but does lack the same level of emotional resonance that its predecessor held.
body: This review is based on a screening timed to the New York Film Festival. Godzilla Minus Zero opens in theaters in Japan on November 3 and in North America on November 6.

Godzilla movies have long had a problem: What do you do after the initial thrill of a quote/unquote serious Godzilla origin story? Can the filmmakers somehow continue the deep thematic underpinnings of that first adventure, even while upping the visual ante with more giant monster action? How do you offer a probing commentary about the world we live in – which is what the best of the genre is known for – when you’ve got skyscraper-sized lizards slugging it out MMA-style?

It is under these circumstances – or should I say restrictions? – that Godzilla Minus Zero enters the ring. As the sequel to the much-praised Godzilla Minus One from three years ago – a picture that dealt with, among other things, notions of survivor’s guilt, hope in the face of hopelessness, found family, and more – Minus Zero is on the ropes from the start. Can returning writer-director Takashi Yamazaki wring even more out of his characters, who have already been to hell and back, while also blowin’ up stuff real good? In a word, no.
points: Review: Godzilla Minus Zero doesn’t disappoint in the slightest on the kaiju front, but does lack the same level of emotional resonance that its predecessor held.

articles.title: Minecraft is getting its first new dimension in 15 years, and it is riotously pink
articles.summary: Since its release in 2011, Minecraft has received countless new biomes, but its number of dimensions has remained consistent over the last fifteen years. But that's all about to change. As of next year, a fourth dimension will soon join the Overworld, the Nether, and the End.
body: The Sift was revealed at the end of Saturday's Minecraft Live. In a brief clip showing the perambulating rabbit strolling through tufts of pink grass beneath a turquoise sky. Mojang didn't reveal much else about the Sift, but being a whole new dimension, players can naturally expect to encounter new mobs, blocks, biomes and so forth.

While the Sift is coming to both Bedrock and Java versions of Minecraft in 2027, players will be able to explore a variant of the dimension before that. This is because the Sift will also appear in Minecraft Dungeons 2 when it releases next week, and we do know a little more about what form the realm will take in Mojang's ARPG sequel.

According to Xbox Wire, The Sift is subject to "shifting tides" that can affect player characters, as well as hazardous new block types and new mobs of both friendly and hostile varieties. The article also names two of the biomes featured in the Sift. One is named Singer's Meadow—a verdant area where all manner of flora grow out of red sculk. The other is called Carapace, which is a desert area dotted with strange blue walls and giant, hollow fossils.

As of next year, a fourth dimension will soon join the Overworld, the Nether, and the End.

articles.title: Lords of the End Times' greatest fantasy is letting us rewrite the most hated lore in Warhammer's history
articles.summary: The end of The End Times.
body: If you told me 10 years back, when I started playing Total War: Warhammer as a brighter-eyed and bushier-tailed strategy gamer, that we'd eventually reach The End Times period, I wouldn't have believed you. But here we are: three games, 110 legendary lords and factions later, Immortal Empires has successfully sliced and diced the best bits of Warhammer Fantasy and chucked them in a big cooking pot of delicious fantasy goodness.

It's both the biggest and best Total War campaign Creative Assembly has ever attempted and you can now play it for just $9 (£7.49) by purchasing any of the characters from the Lords of the End Times expansion. Originally, you had to own all three games, then that was softened to just the third instalment, and now all you need is Boris, Thanquol, Nagash, or The Glottkin, though this version of the campaign doesn't let you play everyone.
